import json,collections
rs=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]; ds=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
for i,s in enumerate(['ъъъъъ','ъьъъъ','ь','ъъъъъ'],90):
 ds.append(dict(item_id=rs[i]['item_id'],slots={str(j+1):c for j,c in enumerate(s)},confidence={str(j+1):'high' for j in range(len(s))},unmarked_final_hard_signs=[],pre1918='yes',note=''))
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for d in ds:f.write(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
checked=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(checked)==len(rs)
for r,d in zip(rs,checked):
 assert r['item_id']==d['item_id']
 expected={str(i+1) for i in range(r['slots'])}
 assert set(d['slots'])==expected and set(d['confidence'])==expected
 assert all(v in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for v in d['slots'].values())
 assert all(v in ['high','low'] for v in d['confidence'].values())
 assert d['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
c=collections.Counter(v for d in checked for v in d['slots'].values())
print('Validated count, order, and slot coverage:',len(checked),'items')
print('Slot calls:',dict(c),'total',sum(c.values()))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(d['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for d in checked))
